• Mumbai City FC vs Sporting Club Delhi || Match Content || Highlights || Match 22 || 01-Nov-2026 || English ||
Comeback of the season in Mumbai! Watch the big moments as Sporting Club Delhi came from 2-0 down to beat Mumbai City FC 3-2 and claim their first win of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Noufal PN set up Muhammad Ajsal and Zothanpuia as Mumbai built a two-goal lead inside 27 minutes. Carlos Fortes started the fightback with 17 minutes left. Stoppage time then belonged to Delhi: Akshat Mehra equalised, and Juan Peña won it three minutes later.
